svg.title: TLGY's trust value a public share and the cash a share paid for redemptions at each vote, December 2021 to June 2026, and USDE's close against the merger's cash a share, June 26 to October 9, 2026
svg.desc: Two panels on one dollar scale. Left, the trust's value a public share, $10.20 at the IPO on December 3, 2021, rising at every report date and extension vote to $13.35 paid at the merger closing on June 25, 2026. Filled dots mark the cash a share paid for redemptions at the six votes, $10.40, $10.96, $11.38, $12.12, $13.20, $13.35. Hollow dots mark the trust's value a share at the IPO and at nine report dates. Right, USDE's close at 74 sessions from June 26, 2026 to October 9, 2026, against a dashed line at $13.35. It closed at $3.70 on its first day, fell to $1.43 on July 24, 2026, rose to $17.25 on September 25, 2026 and closed at $12.30 on October 9, 2026. It closed at or above the dashed line in 11 sessions, all from September 22 to October 7. A dotted line marks the $10.00 IPO unit price in both panels.
svg.text: Redemptions paid $10.40 to $13.35 a share. USDE closed below $13.35 in 63 of 74 sessions
Left, cash a TLGY public share from the 2021 IPO to the 2026 merger. Right, USDE's close from its first session on June 26.
Trust value a share in a filing
